nodes.description: Administrator address of the delegator/market; set to msg.sender in constructor and mutable via _setAdmin.
Governance address with rights to adjust market parameters and implementation; set to msg.sender in constructor and mutable via _setGovernance.
Active implementation (logic) contract that the Delegator forwards all calls to via delegatecall.
Wrapped ETH address used by the market, passed through initialize in the constructor.
Total supply of shard in the market (default 10000000000000000000000).
Stake time limit parameter (default 432000 seconds).
Redeem time limit parameter (default 604800 seconds).
Proportion of shards allocated to the shards creator (default 5).
Proportion of shards allocated to the platform (default 5).
Proportion of market profit given to dev; remainder goes to platformFund (default 20).
Counter of shard pools created in the market.
Constructor: sets admin and governance to msg.sender, sets the implementation and delegatecalls initialize with configuration addresses.
Public function guarded by require(msg.sender == governance) that updates the implementation address.
Public function guarded by require(msg.sender == admin) that updates the admin address.
Public function guarded by require(msg.sender == governance) that updates the governance address.
Internal helper performing a delegatecall to a callee with arbitrary data and reverting with returndata on failure.
Receive function accepting plain ETH transfers with empty calldata.
Fallback function that delegatecalls the current implementation with msg.data and forwards return data or reverts.
External caller address used for authorization in constructor, _setImplementation, _setAdmin, _setGovernance and as the fallback entry point.
callee.delegatecall(data) executed with a caller-supplied callee inside delegateTo, plus inline assembly revert on failure.
implementation.delegatecall(msg.data) in the fallback function, executing arbitrary calldata against the current implementation address.
Inline assembly block in fallback using returndatacopy/return/revert to propagate raw returndata to the caller.
Constructor parameter implementation_ passed to _setImplementation.
Constructor parameter _WETH forwarded to initialize via delegateTo.
Constructor parameter _factory forwarded to initialize via delegateTo.
Constructor parameter _governance forwarded to initialize via delegateTo.
Constructor parameter _router forwarded to initialize via delegateTo.
Parameter implementation_ of _setImplementation, written into the implementation state variable.
Parameter newAdmin of _setAdmin, written into the admin state variable.
Parameter newGovernance of _setGovernance, written into the governance state variable.
Parameter callee of delegateTo; the target address of the delegatecall.
Parameter data of delegateTo; the calldata payload used in the delegatecall.
Local variable in _setImplementation holding the previous implementation address for the NewImplementation event.
Local variable in _setAdmin holding the previous admin address for the NewAdmin event.
Local variable in _setGovernance holding the previous governance address for the NewGovernance event.
Local variable in delegateTo capturing the boolean success flag of the delegatecall.
Local variable in delegateTo holding the returndata bytes from the delegatecall, used in the assembly revert.

edges.reason: msg.sender is written into the admin state variable in the constructor, making the deployer the privileged admin.
msg.sender is written into the governance state variable in the constructor, granting full governance privilege to the deployer.
Constructor assigns admin.
Constructor assigns governance.
Constructor calls _setImplementation(implementation_) to install the initial logic contract.
Constructor calls the internal delegateTo helper to invoke initialize on the implementation.
msg.sender is checked against governance in require before the implementation can be changed.
msg.sender is checked against admin in require before the admin can be changed.
msg.sender is checked against governance in require before governance can be changed.
Any external caller (msg.sender) reaches the fallback and triggers an arbitrary delegatecall to the implementation.
_setAdmin writes the new admin privileged role; guarded only by msg.sender == admin.
_setGovernance writes the governance privileged role; guarded only by msg.sender == governance.
_setImplementation overwrites the implementation state variable that all delegated calls execute against.
Constructor parameter implementation_ is passed into _setImplementation.
Parameter implementation_ flows into the implementation state variable in _setImplementation.
_setImplementation stores the previous implementation in local oldImplementation.
Local oldImplementation reflects the implementation state variable it was copied from.
Parameter newAdmin is written directly into the admin state variable.
Local oldAdmin mirrors the admin state variable in _setAdmin.
Parameter newGovernance is written directly into the governance state variable.
Local oldGovernance mirrors the governance state variable in _setGovernance.
delegateTo invokes the unsafe delegatecall operation on the callee parameter.
fallback invokes the unsafe delegatecall operation against the implementation.
fallback executes the inline assembly block that copies and returns/reverts raw returndata.
The implementation state variable is the target of the delegatecall performed in the fallback.
Parameter callee is the target address of the delegatecall in delegateTo.
Parameter data is the calldata payload supplied to the delegatecall in delegateTo.
Local success controls the branch of the assembly revert/return logic.
Local returnData is the buffer copied by returndatacopy in the assembly revert.
Constructor parameter _WETH is ABI-encoded and forwarded through delegateTo to initialize.
Constructor parameter _factory is forwarded through delegateTo to initialize.
Constructor parameter _governance is forwarded through delegateTo to initialize.
Constructor parameter _router is forwarded through delegateTo to initialize.
